data.li_description:
Datex is a warehouse management software (WMS) company built for growing 3PLs and warehouse operators that need to manage complexity without making their WMS more complicated.

At the center is Footprint® WMS, a modern, cloud-native warehouse management platform designed for operations where customers, workflows and requirements differ, and keep changing. It combines real-time inventory visibility, client-specific workflows, advanced 3PL billing, compliance-focused capabilities and low-code configurability to help operators adapt faster and scale.

With Footprint Analytics and Datex Studio, operators can extend analytics, integrations and workflows as their business evolves.

Hosted on Microsoft Azure, Footprint WMS supports complex and regulated warehouse operations across third-party logistics (3PL), food and beverage, life sciences and industrial distribution.

Founded in 1978 and headquartered in Florida, Datex serves more than 200 clients across the United States and other global markets.

Ready to see Footprint WMS in action? Get a free preview: https://www.datexcorp.com/get-a-preview/.
